title: Voter service centers and election use of council chambers
summary: A pop-up voter service center in Hāna opens tomorrow, running from 10 to 3. Council staff announced it on October 23. The Council held its last session in its chambers for a while that day, so the election crew can take over the space.

timeline.text: A staff member said a Hāna pop-up voter service center opens tomorrow, 10 to 3.
It was the Council's last day in its chambers for a while, so the election crew can take over.
